mapper.select: SELECT u.name AS name, u.status AS status, d.name AS departmentName, u.login_id AS professorNo, u.phone_number AS phoneNum, u.address AS address, u.email AS email, c.name AS collegeName, p.hire_year AS hireYear FROM professors p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id JOIN departments d ON p.department_id = d.id JOIN colleges c ON d.college_id = c.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}
